messages:
maya: quick midday drop — kernel/batcher/KV check-in. did a canary run against slotting changes, saw a p95 regression on small-sequence traffic. attaching brief notes below.

kev: thanks. can you share the p95 numbers and which shard?

maya: p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~320ms on shard-7 during microbursts. cpu spiked to ~94%. logs show repeated eviction cycles. snippet: `latency_p95: 120ms -> 320ms` 

maya: paste logs: ```
2026-03-17T11:03:21Z WARN eviction: shard=7 loop_count=18 reclaimed=0
2026-03-17T11:03:21Z INFO batcher: microbatch_size=1->3 slot_align_retry
```

kev: hmm. that eviction loop_count looks suspicious. did you hit the new kv-prefetch backoff?

maya: i swapped back to old backoff and the p95 dropped to ~140ms. so hypothesis: new backoff + microbatching interacts poorly when slot occupancy is low.

chris: good catch. FYI I merged a mini-fix to batching heuristics (PR #1982) that reduces early slot stealing. maya can you try that branch? link: https://git.redwood/pr/1982

maya: running PR #1982 locally now. repro steps: ```bash
# repro microburst
bazel run //bench:kv_warmup -- --shard=7 --pattern=microburst --iters=500
```

maya: initial run with PR shows p95 ~150ms (better) but still ~20% cpu higher.

kev: interesting. could be kernel scheduler affinity. any kernel config changes in the canary?

maya: no kernel flags changed. i do see more context switches during the hot window. `perf top` shows spin on `evict_check` top func.

sophia: i can take a look at the eviction code path tonight. if it's spin-heavy we might add a backoff sleep or conditional yield.

kev: for short-term mitigation, can we ramp microbatch min_size to 2 for small sequences? that should reduce slot churn.

maya: agree. toggled `microbatch.min_size=2` on canary, reran. p95 -> 135ms, cpu down ~10%.

chris: nice. can we put that as a canary-only config flag and run 4h soak? i'll kick off a canary job. runtime-bot: can you start the soak?

runtime-bot: Started canary-soak job 2026-03-17T12:30:00Z for pr/1982 with config `microbatch.min_size=2` — monitoring p50/p95/cpu every 5m.

maya: blocker: need a quick code review on my follow-up PR that adds a small yield in eviction path (PR #1989). it's tiny but want a second pair of eyes.

sophia: i'm tied into incident on infra but can review in ~45m. if someone else free earlier, pls ping. :eyes:

kev: i'll skim now. main thing: ensure no regressions on long-sequence throughput.

maya: thanks. also quick logistics: planning a short async sync at 17:00 UTC to decide on whether to ship microbatch=min_size=2 as interim. i'll post notes in the calendar.

chris: sounds good. agenda: bench results, soak summary, PR readiness, rollout window.

maya: last note — if the soak looks clean, plan is to ship canary config to Dedicated pools first, then Hosted. will coordinate with release schedule.

kev: ok. i can run an extra perf sweep on long sequences once the soak hits 2h.

sophia: leaving a TODO: if eviction yield helps, we should add a unit microbench for eviction spin counts. i'll draft one after review.

maya: awesome. thanks team. ping me on thread if any immediate issues. :thumbsup:
